Package io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley

package io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
Causal delivery order for Kafka stream processing.

One package, two tiers, shaped as a functional core with imperative edges.

The functional core is the user's logic vocabulary, free of Kafka types: Topic / Codec / Message / Emission / Handler / Fold / Step / Tick / TickHandler / TickFold. Logic is a pure function from a delivered message or tick to emission values, and for folds to the next state as well. It is testable with plain equality and no runtime.

The imperative edges run it. Stage wires logic to topics, and Parsley composes stages. Use testTopology() for broker-less TopologyTestDriver tests, or streams(props) for the CausalStreams runtime, a restricted subset of Kafka Streams with no accessor for the underlying instance. Plain producers and consumers at the application's borders stamp and observe through CausalClock and CausalHeaders, and ContractProbes checks the application contract from the application's own test suite and deploy pipeline. When records wait at the gate, CausalStreams.explainHolds() reports why, as HeldRecord values.

Everything else is package-private on purpose. The protocol implementation is sound only under a host contract no API can enforce: per-channel offset order in, atomic commit of store, offsets and sends, position advances from the real consumer, and partitioning before stamping. The one host that upholds it ships in this package.

The deterministic simulator, the protocol's primary verifier, reaches the internals from the test tree of this same package. It ships as the conformance kit, the test-jar artifact of these coordinates, so a vendored copy or an alternative host can run the same verification.

  • Class
    Description
    CausalClock
    Tracks a plain Kafka client's causal past, so the client can stamp the records it produces.
    CausalHeaders
    Names the record headers the protocol travels in.
    CausalStreams
    A running Parsley application, created by Parsley.streams(Properties) and started here.
    Codec<T>
    A pure byte codec, being two total functions between a value and its bytes.
    ContractProbes
    Executable checks for the application contract.
    ContractProbes.Finding
    Reports one probe result.
    ContractProbes.Report
    Holds the outcome of a probe run: failures to act on, notes to read.
    ContractProbes.Samples
    Collects the sample records ContractProbes.probe(Parsley, ContractProbes.Samples, Path) pipes through the topology.
    CorruptClockException
    A present but undecodable clock header.
    Emission
    One output of user logic, a key and value bound for a topic.
    Fold<S,K,V>
    Stateful user logic, a pure step function over per-key state.
    Handler<K,V>
    Stateless user logic, a pure function from a delivered message to the emissions it causes.
    HeldRecord
    Describes why one record is waiting at the causal gate.
    HeldRecord.Diagnosis
    Indicates what the shape of an unmet claim means.
    HeldRecord.Unmet
    Describes one cause a held record is still waiting for, with the local watermarks that show the gap.
    Message<K,V>
    A causally delivered message, carrying the decoded key and value with the message's own coordinate.
    Parsley
    Composes Stages into a runnable application.
    Stage
    One causal processing stage, with typed source topics, pure user logic, and typed sink topics.
    Stage.Builder
    Builds a stateless stage.
    Stage.Stateful<S>
    Builds a stateful stage, whose sources may fold over the declared per-key state.
    Step<S>
    The result of one Fold application, holding the state to persist for the key and the emissions the message caused.
    Tick
    One delivered tick, a record the stage runtime emits to the stage's own tick channel at the declared interval and consumes back through the causal gate like any other record.
    TickFold<S>
    Stateful tick logic, a pure step function over the stage's tick state.
    TickHandler
    Stateless tick logic, a pure function from a delivered Tick to the emissions it causes.
    Topic<K,V>
    A typed topic, with its name and codecs declared once and then shared.
